title: Skim verification of amended recovery plan
objective: Manually inspect the amended dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md against the seven structural checks listed in back2latex.md verification step 1 — confirming the file is shape-correct before invoking Plan-2-Tasks on it.

plan_assets.asset_description: Seven-bullet verification checklist for the amended plan

scope: Read dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md end-to-end after Phase 1 lands
Run the grep checks specified in back2latex.md amendment 1's risk-mitigation paragraph
implementation_steps: Confirm the Phase ID mapping table is present (P1-1)
Confirm every action-item table has the seven-column header (P1-3)
Confirm each phase has a Code reality anchor (2026-04-26) subsection (P1-4)
Confirm each phase has a Cross-phase dependencies block (P1-5)
Confirm risks table has Affects task(s) column (P1-6)
Confirm Phase 1 lists six tasks P1-1..P1-6 with the supersession task last (P1-7)
Run grep -n 'R[0-6]\.' dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md and confirm hits only appear inside Legacy ID columns
Document any gaps and feed them back as follow-up Phase 1 work before proceeding
deliverables: Inspection note (in conversation or as a brief gates-file entry) confirming all seven checks pass
List of any gaps found, if any, with the Phase 1 task to revisit
acceptance_criteria: All seven structural checks listed in amendment verification step 1 pass
The legacy-ID grep returns nothing outside the Legacy ID column
No outstanding gaps from Phase 1 amendments

cases: Seven phase headings in 1..7 order with (RX) suffix
Action-item tables have the seven required columns
Code reality anchor present on every phase
Cross-phase dependencies block present on every phase
Risks table has Affects task(s) column
Phase 1 lists exactly six tasks ending with the supersession row

risks: Manual skim could miss a missing block — mitigated by pairing each check with a grep command that returns a counted result
completion_notes: All 7 structural checks passed; one minor finding (R2.1 prose reference inside Phase-3 Code reality anchor) fixed in same task by switching to canonical P3-1 ID; Phase-1 audit suite still 27/27.
